description: freeze -> evaluate on counts fabricated from engine C3 predictions plus Bernoulli shot noise (seed 11), on a subset of the committed QC-23 nc_eval circuits (width 8 all 16, width 12 depth<=2 seeds 41,42) with an ARBITRARY parameter file chosen only to exercise the code. The control run draws counts from C0. Frozen format qc26b-frozen-v2: C3 uses delta only (alpha ignored); C3Z is the declared extension (C3 plus alpha) and is reported beside C3, never as the primary comparator. counts_follow_C3Z uses a second arbitrary parameter file with larger alpha so that C3Z differs visibly from C3. Regenerated for the C3Z schema: the previous receipt (format v1) had C3 including the alpha term of the parameter file.
